hint.solid.profile: Sketch the profile on the level plane: click points, A — arc on the last edge, click the first point or Enter to close
hint.solid.top: Sketch the top profile, then close it
hint.solid.axis: Pick two points of the rotation axis
hint.solid.path: Pick the path points (A — arc), Enter to finish
solid.title: Generic model
solid.name: Name
solid.grips: Drag the plan grips: profile and path vertices, the centre moves the element
solid.tip.enter: Type a value and press Enter
hint.solid.hole: Sketch a hole inside the profile and close it; Enter with no points to continue
solid.issue.no3d: Solid {id}: the void is not cut from {what} in 3D (partial, not a prism, or on the boundary)
solid.err.face: The face is nearly vertical: a plan sketch cannot be placed on it — sketch on it in 3D
